necessary_context.applies_to: All selected records; the local-extension interpretation is explicit rather than a quotation of the source.
necessary_context.content: Problem (1.1): X is a closed convex subset of R^n; f,g are continuously differentiable; y*(x)=argmin over all R^m of g(x,y); Phi(x)=f(x,y*(x)). With column gradients, A=g_xy is n by m, H=g_yy is m by m, M=AH^-1, and h=f_x-Mf_y. The submitted local arguments explicitly use local smooth extensions around X for boundary derivatives.
necessary_context.locator: PDF p.1 Eq.(1.1); p.6 Notation and Eq.(2.4)
necessary_context.name: Problem and notation

necessary_context.content: Assumption 1(a): uniformly for x in X, f_x(x,.) and f_y(x,.) are Lipschitz in y with finite positive L_fx,L_fy. 1(b): ||f_y(x,y)||<=C_fy uniformly on X times R^m. 1(c): uniformly in y, f_y(.,y) is Lipschitz on X with finite positive barL_fy. Assumption 2(a): g is continuously twice differentiable in (x,y). 2(b): uniformly in x, g_y(x,.) is Lipschitz with finite positive L_g. 2(c): g(x,.) is uniformly mu_g-strongly convex, mu_g>0, hence H>=mu_g I. 2(d): uniformly in x, A(x,.) and H(x,.) are Lipschitz in y with finite positive L_gxy,L_gyy. 2(e): ||A(x,y)||<=C_gxy uniformly. 2(f): uniformly in y, A(.,y),H(.,y) are Lipschitz on X with finite positive barL_gxy,barL_gyy. The paragraph on p.3 makes Assumptions 1–2 standing throughout the deterministic setting.
necessary_context.locator: PDF p.2 Assumptions 1(a–c),2(a–f); p.3 standing-assumptions paragraph
necessary_context.name: Full standing assumptions

necessary_context.applies_to: Interpretation of derivative bounds and the local hypergradient-bias argument.
necessary_context.content: Definition 1.1 calls the vector or matrix norm Euclidean without explicitly distinguishing induced matrix 2-norm from Frobenius norm. The separately supplied local arguments use Euclidean vector norm and induced matrix 2-norm. Frobenius upper bounds imply the needed operator upper bounds with the same constants. No Frobenius estimate ||H^-1||_F<=1/mu_g is asserted.
necessary_context.name: Matrix norm convention
